A linkage is an assembly of rotating bars that is used to transmit or transform motion. They appear in all sorts of different mechanisms, including suspension systems, windshield wipers, and airplane doors...
In this video we explore what linkages are, how they work, and how a linkage in the cargo door of the McDonnell Douglas DC-10 aircraft was responsible for the crash of Turkish Airlines Flight 981.
